chunks.text:
[Turnaround]
{a short turnaround that leads smoothly straight back into the main theme, same tempo and key}
positive_styles: D major with a wistful minor turn
clear warm pulse-wave and flute lead in a lilting melody
ringing bell-buoy chime arpeggios of broken major chords
deep bell tolling softly beneath the water
rocking compound synth bass with gentle propulsion
soft kick on the downbeat and a light offbeat shaker
dewy, ringing, hopeful open-water discovery, a drowned shrine
seamless transition back to the theme
